title: Tasty Crousty
description: This mod adds the Crousty Street from Tasty Crousty.
body:
![TastyCroustyTitle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a737f244c8bf0c67df8be3a483ed43b43b30bfa4.png)

The **Tasty Crousty mod**, inspired by the fast-food chain of the same name. 

**Item :**

-**Crousty Street** (A dish made with rice, chicken and homemade sauce)

- _5 hunger bars_
- _0.8 saturation_

More will be added in the future!

🌍 Supported Languages

-English 🇬🇧​-French 🇫🇷

🔨​ This mod is still **under development**, so it **isn't complete yet** (the recipe and some menus are missing)​​
